issue.title: sase stats project: one shared Projects report with honest model attribution
issue.description: `sase stats project` and the Admin Center's Statistics → Projects tab render one Rust-backed report through the same loader, view model, legends, and section renderers. The report shows landed commits and committed plans attributed to a provider/model with visible coverage, a lifetime code snapshot, and this machine's agent runs. Every new agent commit and proposed plan records its model at write time.

payload.entry: CLEAN-BASE REPRODUCTION: The final E1 ToolRun 20c517b32902455dddee1b8dde1b449b surfaced the same two Python 3.14.7 stats parser-help failures. I recreated an unmodified worktree at primary HEAD a9046529ca and ran test_project_help_golden plus test_project_help_includes_definitions_and_examples there; both failed identically in 5.05 seconds. The golden expects the Python 3.12 spelling -f {json,markdown,rich}, --format, while Python 3.14 emits -f, --format {json,markdown,rich}. This confirms the final E1 check failures reproduce on the clean base and are outside E1. The existing corroboration on sase-14p already records the cross-version argparse help-formatting root cause; no new task was created.

Land profiling at 4e5b7d2eb6: warm output ~2.1 s, runs ~0.53 s, code ~1.6 s, request build ~0.28 s; ~48% of py-spy samples sleep in the 5 ms child-exit poll (file_history/runner.rs WAIT_POLL_INTERVAL) and one tiny project costs ~60 git spawns per warm query.
